reference.role: Banner visual style and palette reference only

options.name: Classic Sweep
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Last Light Radio YouTube channel profile picture.
Input image 1: visual style and color reference ONLY, the creator's selected Last Light Radio banner. Create a NEW square avatar, do not edit the banner.
Match the reference closely: ink midnight navy, aged warm ivory, honey amber light, subtle antique print grain, restrained cinematic glow, quiet late-night analog-radio mood. Limited palette, tasteful minimal identity, no chrome, no modern app icon gloss. The avatar should feel designed as part of exactly the same identity as this banner.
Output ONE square image, 1024 x 1024 requested, edge-to-edge opaque midnight navy background. This is the actual avatar artwork, no contact sheet, labels, mockup or surrounding layout. Design for a circular crop: every meaningful detail fits inside a circle centered at (512,512), radius 390. Main symbol large and bold enough to recognize when displayed at 48 pixels. Texture subtle and subordinate to shape. Strong silhouette, few thick deliberate elements, elegant negative space.
NO letters, words, initials, numbers, frequencies, clock numerals, motto, station name, music notes, headphones, characters, watermarks or additional badges. A radio tuning symbol, not a clock or compass.
DIRECTION: a beautifully balanced vintage circular radio tuning dial seen directly from the front. A single warm ivory 270-degree arc open at the bottom, about 28px thick at this canvas size, with a restrained set of roughly 11 chunky inward tuning ticks, every third tick longer. One long luminous amber tuning needle extends from a simple amber hub up toward the upper-right arc at roughly two o'clock, with a soft localized warm bloom where it reaches the arc. Only ONE needle. The inner face is dark navy and open. Warm ivory arc, amber needle, soft smoky antique texture. No text anywhere. Express nighttime radio with a bold timeless emblem, not literal machinery or an instrument dashboard.
